title: Coal India MT CS/IT 2023 — Previous Year Paper

questions.question: Choose the correct antonym for 'BENEVOLENT':
questions.explanation: Benevolent means well-meaning and kindly. Its antonym is Malevolent (wishing evil or harm).
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The committee ________ divided in their opinions.
questions.explanation: When a collective noun like 'committee' acts as individuals having differing opinions, it takes a plural verb ('were').
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Identify the passive voice: 'They built this bridge in 1995.'
options: This bridge had been built in 1995.
This bridge built by them in 1995.
questions.explanation: Simple past active 'built' becomes 'was built' in passive voice.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Find the correctly spelt word:
questions.explanation: Accommodate has double 'c' and double 'm'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: What does the idiom 'Break the ice' mean?
options: To make people feel comfortable in a social setting
questions.explanation: 'Break the ice' means to initiate conversation and overcome social awkwardness.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Substitute one word: 'A person who collects or studies stamps'
questions.explanation: A philatelist is a person who studies or collects postage stamps.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the synonym for 'CANDID':
questions.explanation: Candid means truthful and straightforward; Frank.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He is senior ________ me in service.
questions.explanation: Adjectives ending in '-ior' like senior, junior, superior take 'to' instead of 'than'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Spot the error: 'Neither of the two candidates have submitted their application.'
questions.explanation: 'Neither' is singular and requires the singular verb 'has submitted'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in: She ran as fast as she ________.
questions.explanation: Past tense main clause ('ran') requires past modal auxiliary 'could'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Select the correct indirect speech: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
options: He said that he was reading a book.
He said that he is reading a book.
He told that he read a book.
He said he had been reading a book.
questions.explanation: Present continuous 'am reading' becomes past continuous 'was reading' in reported speech.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Meaning of 'Burn the candle at both ends':
options: To exhaust oneself by working late and getting up early
questions.explanation: It means to overwork oneself by going to bed late and getting up early.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Antonym for 'METICULOUS':
questions.explanation: Meticulous means taking extreme care; Careless is the opposite.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Rearrange into coherent sentence: P: of renewable energy Q: the rapid growth R: has reduced S: carbon emissions
questions.explanation: The rapid growth (Q) of renewable energy (P) has reduced (R) carbon emissions (S).
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Which of the following is an adjective in: 'She wore a beautiful necklace.'?
questions.explanation: 'Beautiful' modifies the noun 'necklace' and is an adjective.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Choose the plural of 'Criterion':
questions.explanation: Criterion is of Greek origin; its plural is Criteria.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Synonym of 'PERSEVERANCE':
questions.explanation: Perseverance means continued effort despite difficulties; Persistence.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Fill in: No sooner did he reach the station ________ the train left.
questions.explanation: 'No sooner' is always paired with 'than'.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Choose the correct spelling:
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is Entrepreneur.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Meaning of 'Once in a blue moon':
questions.explanation: 'Once in a blue moon' means something that occurs very rarely.
questions.subject: General English

questions.question: Where is the headquarters of Coal India Limited (CIL) situated?
questions.explanation: Coal India Limited headquarters is located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which subsidiary of CIL is the largest coal-producing company in India?
questions.explanation: MCL (Mahanadi Coalfields Limited) is one of the top coal producing subsidiaries of CIL.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: In India, Coal India Limited is designated as a:
questions.explanation: CIL was conferred Maharatna status by the Government of India in April 2011.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which fundamental right cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency?
questions.explanation: Articles 20 (protection in respect of conviction for offences) and 21 (protection of life and personal liberty) cannot be suspended during an emergency.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: The Booker Prize is awarded annually for the best work in which field?
questions.explanation: The Booker Prize is a prestigious literary award conferred each year for the best original novel written in English.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which Indian state has the maximum coal reserves?
questions.explanation: Jharkhand holds the highest coal reserves in India, primarily in the Jharia coalfield region.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution empowers the President to declare a Financial Emergency?
questions.explanation: Article 360 deals with the declaration of Financial Emergency.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Who was appointed as the Governor of Reserve Bank of India in December 2018?
questions.explanation: Shaktikanta Das assumed charge as the 25th Governor of RBI in December 2018.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What is the primary constituent of Natural Gas?
questions.explanation: Methane (CH4) makes up around 70-90% of natural gas.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: In which city is the Central Institute of Mining and Fuel Research (CIMFR) located?
questions.explanation: CSIR-CIMFR is located in Dhanbad, Jharkhand.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Who is known as the Father of Indian Space Program?
questions.explanation: Dr. Vikram Sarabhai is considered the father of the Indian space program.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which river is known as the 'Sorrow of Bengal'?
questions.explanation: Damodar River was historically called the 'Sorrow of Bengal' due to devastating floods.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: NITI Aayog replaced which of the following commissions in 2015?
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) replaced the Planning Commission on January 1, 2015.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which gas is released during coal seam gas extraction (Coal Bed Methane)?
questions.explanation: Coalbed Methane (CBM) is an unconventional form of natural gas found in coal deposits.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: The International Court of Justice (ICJ) is headquartered at:
questions.explanation: The ICJ is located at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which spectrum color has the shortest wavelength?
questions.explanation: Violet has the shortest wavelength (around 380-450 nm) in the visible spectrum.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which Maharatna PSU company operates the Jharia and Raniganj coalfields?
questions.explanation: Bharat Coking Coal Limited (BCCL) and Eastern Coalfields Limited (ECL) operate in Jharia and Raniganj under CIL.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Who wrote the national anthem 'Jana Gana Mana'?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore composed Jana Gana Mana originally in Bengali.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: Which device converts Chemical Energy into Electrical Energy?
questions.explanation: An electrochemical cell or battery converts chemical energy into electrical energy.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: When is National Science Day celebrated in India?
questions.explanation: National Science Day is celebrated on 28th February to mark the discovery of Raman Effect by Sir C.V. Raman.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSort?
questions.explanation: QuickSort takes O(n²) time in the worst case when the pivot chosen is always the extreme element (e.g. already sorted array).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which Data Structure uses LIFO (Last In First Out) principle?
questions.explanation: Stack works on Last In First Out (LIFO) order.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which RAID level provides striping with dual distributed parity?
questions.explanation: RAID 6 uses block-level striping with two distributed parity blocks per array.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the maximum number of nodes in a binary tree of height h (where root is at height 1)?
questions.explanation: Max nodes in a binary tree of height h = 2^0 + 2^1 + ... + 2^(h-1) = 2^h - 1.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In SQL, which clause is used to filter groups created by GROUP BY?
questions.explanation: HAVING clause is used to filter aggregated group results.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which transport layer protocol is connectionless and un-reliable?
questions.explanation: UDP (User Datagram Protocol) is a lightweight connectionless transport layer protocol.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Banker's Algorithm is used for:
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's Banker's Algorithm is a deadlock avoidance algorithm testing for safe states.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the size of an IPv6 address?
questions.explanation: IPv6 addresses are 128 bits long.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In B-Tree of order m, every internal node except root has at least how many children?
questions.explanation: Every non-root internal node in a B-Tree of order m has at least ceil(m/2) children.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is ACID property 'I' in database management?
questions.explanation: ACID stands for Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which algorithm is used for finding Minimum Spanning Tree?
questions.explanation: Kruskal's and Prim's algorithms are greedy algorithms used to find MST.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which layer in OSI model performs data compression and encryption?
questions.explanation: Presentation Layer (Layer 6) handles syntax translation, data formatting, encryption, and compression.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: A scheduling algorithm assigns CPU to the process with smallest execution time. This is called:
questions.explanation: SJF selects the process with the shortest burst time for execution.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which of the following is a non-linear data structure?
questions.explanation: Trees and Graphs are non-linear data structures. Arrays, Lists, and Queues are linear.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching an element in a balanced Binary Search Tree (BST)?
questions.explanation: Searching in a balanced BST takes O(log n) time.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which Normal Form removes Partial Functional Dependency?
questions.explanation: 2NF eliminates partial dependencies (non-prime attribute depending on proper subset of candidate key).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: A process transitions from Running to Ready state because of:
questions.explanation: A running process moves back to Ready state when preempted by timer interrupt or higher priority process.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which IP address range belongs to Class C network?
questions.explanation: Class C IP addresses range from 192.0.0.0 to 223.255.255.255.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the degree of a root node in a binary tree if it has 2 child nodes?
questions.explanation: The degree of a node is the total number of children it has.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Object-Oriented Programming, wrapping data and methods into a single unit is known as:
questions.explanation: Encapsulation binds together code and the data it manipulates, keeping both safe from outside interference.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which grammar in Chomsky hierarchy can be recognized by a Deterministic Finite Automaton (DFA)?
questions.explanation: Type 3 Regular grammars are accepted by Finite Automata (DFA/NFA).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which compiler phase checks for grammatical structure and builds a Parse Tree?
questions.explanation: Syntax analysis (Parser) takes tokens and generates a parse tree according to formal grammar.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which software engineering model is also known as Linear Sequential Model?
questions.explanation: The Waterfall model is a sequential software development process.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which protocol is used by ping utility to test network reachability?
questions.explanation: Ping uses ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) Echo Request and Echo Reply messages.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is Belady's Anomaly in Operating Systems?
options: More page frames lead to fewer page faults
More page frames lead to more page faults in FIFO page replacement
CPU utilization drops when multiprogramming increases
questions.explanation: Belady's Anomaly is the phenomenon where increasing page frames increases page faults for FIFO replacement.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: The worst case space complexity of Depth First Search (DFS) on a graph with depth d is:
questions.explanation: DFS space complexity is proportional to maximum recursion depth d, i.e., O(d).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is a Foreign Key in a relational database?
options: A key that uniquely identifies a row in its own table
A column or set of columns in one table that references the primary key of another table
An encrypted key for remote access
questions.explanation: A foreign key enforces referential integrity by referencing primary key of another relation.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which scheduling algorithm gives minimum average waiting time?
questions.explanation: Preemptive Shortest Job First (SRTF) is optimal and yields minimum average waiting time.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which port number is used by HTTP by default?
questions.explanation: HTTP uses port 80; HTTPS uses port 443.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In C++, which keyword is used to declare a dynamic memory allocation?
questions.explanation: 'new' operator allocates memory dynamically on the heap in C++.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which logic gate outputs 1 only when all inputs are 1?
questions.explanation: AND gate outputs 1 if and only if all inputs are 1.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: The Dual of boolean expression (A + 0) = A is:
questions.explanation: Duality principle replaces + with . and 0 with 1. So (A + 0) = A becomes A . 1 = A.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: How many select lines are required for a 16-to-1 Multiplexer?
questions.explanation: 2^n = 16 => n = 4 select lines required.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which addressing mode specifies the operand location directly within the instruction?
questions.explanation: In Immediate Addressing Mode, the operand value is explicitly given inside the instruction itself (e.g. MOV R1, #5).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: A Cache Miss where data is accessed for the first time is called:
questions.explanation: Compulsory/Cold miss occurs when data is requested for the very first time.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which data structure is best suited for Breadth First Search (BFS) graph traversal?
questions.explanation: BFS uses a Queue to explore graph level by level.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the worst case time complexity of Merge Sort?
questions.explanation: Merge sort divides array into halves consistently, yielding O(n log n) in all cases.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which relational algebra operator selects tuples that satisfy a given predicate?
questions.explanation: Selection operator (σ) filters rows/tuples based on condition.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: A Semaphore S initialized to 1 is used for:
questions.explanation: A binary semaphore (value 0 or 1) acts as a Mutex lock.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the subnet mask for a Class B IP network by default?
questions.explanation: Class B uses 16 network bits and 16 host bits, default subnet mask 255.255.0.0.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Post-order traversal of a binary tree visits nodes in order:
questions.explanation: Post-order traversal order: Left Subtree → Right Subtree → Root Node.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Software Testing, checking system components without executing code is:
questions.explanation: Static testing involves code reviews, walkthroughs, and inspections without running code.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Cyclomatic Complexity of a flow graph with E edges and N nodes and P connected components is:
questions.explanation: McCabe's Cyclomatic Complexity V(G) = E - N + 2P.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which collision resolution technique in Hashing uses open addressing with linear probing?
questions.explanation: Linear probing checks consecutive slots (i + 1, i + 2...) linearly upon collision.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: The time complexity to find an item in a Hash Table with good hash function is:
questions.explanation: With uniform hashing and low load factor, average search time is O(1).
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In ER Diagrams, an Entity Set that does not have sufficient attributes to form a primary key is:
questions.explanation: A Weak Entity Set depends on an identifying owner entity set and uses a discriminator/partial key.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which protocol works at Data Link Layer to map IP address to MAC address?
questions.explanation: ARP maps 32-bit IPv4 addresses to 48-bit Ethernet MAC addresses.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Virtual Memory is implemented using:
questions.explanation: Virtual memory uses Paging and Demand Segmentation supported by MMU.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In COCOMO model, software projects are categorized into three modes: Organic, Semidetached, and:
questions.explanation: COCOMO categorizes projects into Organic, Semi-detached, and Embedded modes based on complexity.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which type of language is generated by Context Free Grammar (CFG)?
questions.explanation: CFG generates Context Free Languages, recognized by Pushdown Automata.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Pumping Lemma for Regular Languages is primarily used to:
options: Prove a given language is regular
Prove a given language is NOT regular
questions.explanation: Pumping Lemma is a proof tool used to show that a language is NOT regular.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which flip-flop converts into T flip-flop when its inputs J and K are connected together?
questions.explanation: Tying J and K inputs together converts a JK flip-flop into a Toggle (T) flip-flop.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the maximum number of edges in an undirected simple graph with n vertices?
questions.explanation: Max edges in undirected simple graph = nC2 = n(n-1)/2.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In Symmetric Key Cryptography:
options: Same key is used for both Encryption and Decryption
Public key encrypts and Private key decrypts
questions.explanation: Symmetric encryption uses a single shared secret key for encryption and decryption.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the main objective of Normalization in DBMS?
options: Eliminate Data Redundancy and avoid anomalies
questions.explanation: Normalization organizes fields and tables to minimize redundancy and dependency anomalies.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Thrashing in Operating System occurs when:
options: CPU spends more time paging than executing processes
questions.explanation: Thrashing happens when system spends more time swapping pages in/out than doing useful work.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: A Deadlock State can be broken by:
questions.explanation: Recovery from deadlock involves terminating processes or preempting resources.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: Which protocol handles secure remote login over encrypted channels?
questions.explanation: SSH operates over port 22 providing encrypted remote shell logins.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: What is the time complexity of Heapify operation in Heap Sort?
questions.explanation: Heapify takes O(log n) time to maintain heap property for a single node down the tree.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)

questions.question: In a Compiler, intermediate code generation produces code that is:
options: Machine independent and easy to translate to target code
questions.explanation: Intermediate Representation (IR) is machine-independent, facilitating portability and optimization.
questions.subject: Technical (CS/IT)
